Detailed Description

Derived sampling and checking class used by CPHY PPI components to register control signal related checks.

Member Function Documentation

  function void
 svt_mipi_cphy_ppi_common_err_check::new
 (  string err_check_name = "", bit register_default_chks = 1, bit enable_default_chks = 1, bit enable_pass_cov = 0, bit enable_fail_cov = 1, svt_mipi_cphy_configuration cfg = null, string signal_info  ) 

CONSTRUCTOR: Create a new svt_mipi_cphy_ppi_common_err_check instance.

err_check_name - A string that identifies this particular svt_err_check instance.

register_default_chks - A bit that identifies whether or not the default checks associated with this sampling/checking class should be registered automatically.

enable_default_chks - A bit that identifies whether or not the default checks associated with this sampling/checking class should be enabled. This bit only has meaning if register_default_checks is set to 1.

enable_pass_cov - A bit that identifies whether or not the PASS checks coverage should be enabled.

enable_fail_cov - A bit that identifies whether or not the FAIL checks coverage should be enabled.

cfg - CPHY configuration class handle.

signal_info - TX or RX signals associated with these common checks.

  function void
 svt_mipi_cphy_ppi_common_err_check::register_default_checks
 (  bit enable_checks = 1  ) 

This method is called by the constructor if the register_default_checks parameter is set to 1.

enable_checks - A bit that identifies whether or not the checks that are registered by this function should be enabled or disabled.

 svt_err_check_stats  attribute
 svt_mipi_cphy_ppi_common_err_check::cphy_ppi_direction_0_vs_rx_signals_check

Check that,after configurable initialization time period (SVT_MIPI_CPHY_PPI_INIT_PERIOD), when Direction is 0 i.e. Lane is in Transmit Mode then RX signals should remain in their default state.
  • List of RX signals :
    • Rx_Active_HS
    • Rx_Valid_HS
    • Rx_Data_Width_HS
    • Rx_LPDT_Esc
    • Rx_ULPS_Esc
    • Rx_TRIGGER_Esc
  • Default value of define SVT_MIPI_CPHY_PPI_INIT_PERIOD is 100.
